design.selection_rule: Per fly: rescue every damaged class singly; per readout take the 3 classes with the largest single-class restored fraction and take the union (chosen classes); pool all damaged types of the chosen classes, sort by number of removed neurons in that fly (descending) and keep the first 400; add 50 random control types drawn from types outside the chosen classes (rng default_rng(31000+seed)); single neurons: union over readouts of the 5 most effective tested types, up to 20 neurons per type with the most synapses (in+out); cumulative: top 1, 3, 10, 30 types per readout in order of their single-type fraction.
definitions.deficit: Throughout this file 'deficit' means the fly's healthy-minus-damaged difference of a readout when |healthy - damaged| > 5% of |healthy|, in EITHER direction (analyze_exp1.frac_table, as in exp1_stats.py). Fly-readout pairs whose damaged value is ABOVE healthy are kept with a negative denominator: screen WB 0, LH 0, KC 2, MBON 4, MN9 4, GF 0 flies (seeds in k.n_flies_damaged_above_healthy.*). For them a positive restored fraction means the variant moved the readout down toward healthy, and a small denominator can give values far outside 0-1 (fly 1266 MBON). A fraction > 1 means the readout moved past healthy (overshoot). Pooled medians include these flies; *.all_deficit_only keys repeat the main medians without them. The robust (g., h.) and confirm (i.) tables use the same rule on their own baselines.

_meaning.design.code.restored_neurons_keep_thresh: counterfactual.py: Variant.shift defaults to True and vth_vector subtracts the fly's dth from restored neurons, so restored neurons return at the shifted threshold (v_th - 2 mV x load), not the healthy value.
